text:
Harper: Customer 'pegasus' reports a burst of SCIM duplicate users after the RBAC role rename. Provisioner logs show KMS decrypt failures and fallback creates. Can infra/security triage?

Jin: ACK. Paste minimal logs and the SAML/OIDC sample if available.

Harper: Logs (sanitized):
2026-09-12T18:03:12Z ERROR provisioner: decrypt extid failed: kms.InvalidCiphertextException: encryption context mismatch
2026-09-12T18:03:12Z INFO provisioner: decrypt failed -> fallback to userName -> created svc-pegasus-ingest-2
SAML NameID sample: NameID Format=\"persistent\">acct|svc-pegasus-ingest

Aria: Two likely causes: 1) upstream IdP changed the NameID delimiter so our parser returned different stable ids after RBAC rename; 2) KMS rewrap/alias update removed tenant metadata from DestinationEncryptionContext, causing decrypt mismatch.

Diego: Immediate actions: pause SCIM inbound for pegasus, rollback alias or rewrap back to canonical key with correct encryption context, and add a guard in provisioner to avoid auto-creating when decrypt fails (enqueue to dedupe-review).

infra-bot: KMS event: 2026-09-12T17:59:50Z AliasUpdate alias/tenant-extid-pegasus -> keyId=ppp-202; DestinationEncryptionContext omitted "tenant" in 18/200 re-encrypts.

Jin: Mitigation plan: 1) pause provisioning (Harper/CS); 2) rollback alias and re-apply key policy ensuring provisioner role arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/provisioner has Decrypt/ReEncrypt; 3) run server-side ReEncrypt rewrap for affected blobs with DestinationEncryptionContext {"tenant":"pegasus","purpose":"extid"} (dry-run then full); 4) ship provisioner audit-shim that writes ciphertext_hmac + reason before decrypt and refuses to auto-create on decrypt failure.

Harper: I'll notify customer and pause provisioning. security-bot open incident.

security-bot: Incident SEC-2026-212 created: \"pegasus SCIM dupes: KMS rewrap context missing + NameID format drift\" https://redwood.incidents/SEC-2026-212

Aria: Add recon job to dedupe created duplicates once rewrap completes: `recon-scim --tenant=pegasus --strategy merge-on-externalId`. Also plan a short retrospective to prevent partner/key ops from omitting encryption context in rewraps.

Diego: I'll run a dry-run rewrap sample=50 with preserve-context flag at 18:25Z and report results. Jin, please prepare the key-policy diff to re-add provisioner role if needed.

infra-bot: Dry-run started.

Harper: Keep posting updates here. If anyone is blocked ping @oncall-bot. :white_check_mark:
